label: Town of Bolton
header:
# Town of Bolton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Bolton official website, Select Board page: lists Victoria Raymond (Chair), Rich Reid (Vice-Chair), Paula Gervia, Ryan Farrell, and Mica Cassara, with term expirations running to 2027, 2028, and 2029. (The Secretary of State's directory publishes no Bolton roster.) The 2026 Town Report's officials table prints stale names ('Victoria Haler', 'Leah Scott') that the current Select Board page supersedes.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michael Webber as Town Clerk of Bolton and as Town Treasurer of Bolton.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table (report p. 4) lists Michael Webber as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (elected 2024, three-year terms).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michael Webber as Town Clerk of Bolton and as Town Treasurer of Bolton.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table (report p. 4) lists Michael Webber as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (elected 2024, three-year terms).

Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table lists Leslie Petch as Town Moderator (elected 2025, one-year term expiring 2026). The seat stood for election in March 2026 and the town publishes no outcome, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'Hired and Appointed Town Officials' table (report p. 5) lists the Delinquent Tax Collector as Michael Webber, appointed 2024; the membership is recorded as appointed.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'Hired and Appointed Town Officials' table (report p. 5) lists the Town Constable as a vacant appointed position; the office is recorded with no holder.

Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table lists the Cemetery Commission as Penny Tinker (term expiring 2028) and Cheryl Mendicino (term expiring 2027), with the third seat vacant, so only Tinker and Mendicino are recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: the report's elected and appointed officer tables list no grand juror, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: the report's elected and appointed officer tables list no town agent, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table lists the Justices of the Peace elected in 2024 (two-year terms) as Paula Gervia, Rich Reid, John Devine, Steve Diglio, and Jane Agran.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the listing's text prints only first names for Bolton (Brenda, Paula, Richard, John, Steve, with surnames not extractable). Four match the town report's slate; the fifth first name, 'Brenda', does not match the town report's Jane Agran and is unexplained. The town report, the official source publishing full names, governs Bolton's slate.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the listing's text prints only first names for Bolton, so the winners are recorded from the Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report (see the post's sources). They are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office.
Town of Bolton 2026 Town Report: 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS' table lists the Justices of the Peace elected in 2024 as Paula Gervia, Rich Reid, John Devine, Steve Diglio, and Jane Agran.
